translations.EN: I'm hurt and down! Need a bandage over here!
translations.TL: Sugatan ako at nakahandusay! Kailangan ko ng benda rito!

translations.EN: Deep cut... I need a bandage now!
translations.TL: Malalim ang sugat... kailangan ko ng benda ngayon din!

translations.EN: I can't stop this wound alone! Bring a bandage!
translations.TL: Hindi ko mapatigil ang sugat nang mag-isa! Magdala ka ng benda!

translations.EN: Patch me up, please! I'm losing blood!
translations.TL: Bendahan mo ako, pakiusap! Nauubusan ako ng dugo!

translations.EN: I'm down! Does anyone have a clean rag or bandage?!
translations.TL: Bagsak ako! May malinis ba kayong basahan o benda?!

translations.EN: Gash on my leg... need wrapping right now!
translations.TL: May hiwa sa binti ko... kailangang balutin ngayon din!

translations.EN: Help! I need these wounds dressed!
translations.TL: Tulong! Kailangang gamutin ang mga sugat na 'to!

translations.EN: I'm on the floor, bleeding! Get a bandage over here!
translations.TL: Nasa sahig ako, dumurugo! Dalhan mo ako ng benda rito!

translations.EN: Need a patch immediately! I'm grounded!
translations.TL: Kailangan ng panapal agad! Hindi ako makatayo!

translations.EN: Bandage, quick! I can't get up without one!
translations.TL: Benda, bilis! Hindi ako makakabangon kung wala 'yan!

translations.EN: I'm bleeding out! I need a tourniquet or bandage now!
translations.TL: Nauubusan ako ng dugo! Kailangan ko ng benda ngayon din!

translations.EN: Dying here! The blood won't stop flowing!
translations.TL: Nalalagutan ako ng hininga! Ayaw tumigil ng agos ng dugo!

translations.EN: I'm losing too much blood... getting cold!
translations.TL: Masyadong maraming dugo ang nawawala... nilalamig na ako!

translations.EN: Hit an artery! Put pressure on this right now!
translations.TL: Tinamaan ang ugat! Diinan mo 'to ngayon din!

translations.EN: Everything's going dark... stop the bleeding, please!
translations.TL: Dumidilim ang paningin ko... patigilin mo ang dugo, pakiusap!

translations.EN: I'm bleeding through my clothes! Help me!
translations.TL: Bumabaon ang dugo sa damit ko! Tulungan mo ako!

translations.EN: Blood everywhere... please, I don't want to die here!
translations.TL: Nagkalat ang dugo... pakiusap, ayaw kong mamatay rito!

translations.EN: Losing consciousness... plug this wound!
translations.TL: Nawawalan ako ng malay... tapalan mo ang sugat na 'to!

translations.EN: Hurry! I'm bleeding out on the dirt!
translations.TL: Bilis! Nauubusan ako ng dugo sa lupa!

translations.EN: Can't feel my fingers... stop the blood!
translations.TL: Hindi ko na maramdaman ang daliri ko... patigilin ang dugo!

translations.EN: I'm down! I need help over here!
translations.TL: Bagsak ako! Kailangan ko ng tulong dito!

translations.EN: Can't stand! Someone help me up!
translations.TL: Hindi ako makatayo! Tulungan niyo akong makatayo!

translations.EN: I'm hit! Get over here!
translations.TL: Tinamaan ako! Halika rito!

translations.EN: Need medical attention immediately!
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng agarang panggagamot!

translations.EN: Down and helpless! Don't leave me!
translations.TL: Bagsak at walang laban! Huwag niyo akong iwan!

translations.EN: I took a bad fall! Help me!
translations.TL: Napasama ang bagsak ko! Tulungan mo ako!

translations.EN: Can't get back on my feet! Help!
translations.TL: Hindi ako makabangon! Tulong!

translations.EN: Hurt bad! Over here, please!
translations.TL: Malubha ang tama ko! Dito, pakiusap!

translations.EN: I'm down on the ground! Need a hand!
translations.TL: Nasa sahig ako! Pasaklolo naman!

translations.EN: Injured and stranded! Come help!
translations.TL: Sugatan at nastranded! Tulungan niyo ako!

translations.EN: So thirsty... I need water before I pass out.
translations.TL: Uhaw na uhaw na ako... kailangan ko ng tubig bago ako mahimatay.

translations.EN: Throat is completely parched... please, any water?
translations.TL: Tuyong-tuyo na ang lalamunan ko... pakiusap, may tubig ba?

translations.EN: Drying out... can barely swallow. Water, please.
translations.TL: Nanghihina sa uhaw... halos hindi makalunok. Tubig, pakiusap.

translations.EN: I'm too dehydrated to move my legs. Water...
translations.TL: Masyado akong dehydrated para maigalaw ang binti ko. Tubig...

translations.EN: Give me a sip of water... dying of thirst.
translations.TL: Pahingi ng kahit kaunting tubig... mamamatay na ako sa uhaw.

translations.EN: Lips are cracked and bleeding... need clean water.
translations.TL: Nangangapal at nagdurugo ang labi ko... kailangan ng malinis na tubig.

translations.EN: Can't walk anymore... please bring a water bottle.
translations.TL: Hindi na makalakad... pakiusap dalhan mo ako ng tubig.

translations.EN: Head is pounding from dehydration... need a drink.
translations.TL: Pumipintig ang ulo ko sa uhaw... kailangang uminom.

translations.EN: I'm collapsing... just a few drops of water.
translations.TL: Bumabagsak na ako... kahit ilang patak lang ng tubig.

translations.EN: Water... please, someone hand me water.
translations.TL: Tubig... pakiusap, bigyan niyo ako ng tubig.

translations.EN: Pushed too far. I can't lift my arms.
translations.TL: Nasobrahan ako. Hindi ko na maitaas ang mga braso ko.

translations.EN: Completely spent... give me a moment to recover.
translations.TL: Ubos na ubos na ang lakas ko... bigyan mo ako ng saglit para makabawi.

translations.EN: Legs gave out beneath me. Need to sit.
translations.TL: Bumigay ang mga binti ko. Kailangan kong umupo.

translations.EN: Can't move another step. Total exhaustion.
translations.TL: Hindi na makakahakbang pa. Sagad na pagod na.

translations.EN: Breathing hurts. I need rest right now.
translations.TL: Masakit huminga. Kailangan ko ng pahinga ngayon din.

translations.EN: Collapsed from fatigue... give me five minutes.
translations.TL: Bumagsak sa matinding pagod... bigyan mo ako ng limang minuto.

translations.EN: Muscles are locking up. Can't stand.
translations.TL: Naninigas na ang kalamnan ko. Hindi makatayo.

translations.EN: I have nothing left in the tank. Need a break.
translations.TL: Wala nang natitirang lakas. Kailangan ng pahinga.

translations.EN: Vision is swimming from exhaustion. Give me time.
translations.TL: Umiikot ang paningin ko sa pagod. Bigyan mo ako ng oras.

translations.EN: Body won't respond... let me rest a second.
translations.TL: Ayaw nang gumalaw ng katawan ko... pahingahin mo muna ako.

translations.EN: I'm down! Please, don't kill me!
translations.TL: Bagsak na ako! Pakiusap, huwag mo akong patayin!

translations.EN: Mercy, please! I'm completely unarmed!
translations.TL: Maawa ka, pakiusap! Wala akong sandata!

translations.EN: Don't shoot! I'm already defeated!
translations.TL: Huwag kang puputok! Talo na ako!

translations.EN: Please let me live! I surrender!
translations.TL: Pakiusap buhayin mo ako! Sumusuko na ako!

translations.EN: Spare me, please! I have nothing left!
translations.TL: Patawarin mo ako, pakiusap! Wala nang natira sa akin!

translations.EN: I beg you... don't finish me off!
translations.TL: Nagmamakaawa ako sa'yo... huwag mo akong tapusin!

translations.EN: I yield! Don't strike again!
translations.TL: Suko na ako! Huwag ka nang humataw ulit!

translations.EN: Show mercy! I'm bleeding out on the floor!
translations.TL: Maawa ka! Nauubusan na ako ng dugo sa sahig!

translations.EN: Don't hurt me anymore, please!
translations.TL: Huwag mo na akong saktan pa, pakiusap!

translations.EN: Have a heart... let me survive this.
translations.TL: Maawa ka naman... hayaan mo akong mabuhay.

translations.EN: I'm trapped here! I need help over here!
translations.TL: Naipit ako rito! Kailangan ko ng tulong dito!

translations.EN: Can't move on my own! Pull me out!
translations.TL: Hindi ako makagalaw mag-isa! Hilahin mo ako palabas!

translations.EN: Pinned down and injured! Come get me!
translations.TL: Naiipit at sugatan! Halika kunin mo ako!

translations.EN: Over here! Don't leave me stranded!
translations.TL: Dito! Huwag niyo akong iwang nastranded!

translations.EN: I'm stuck behind rubble! Need someone to clear it!
translations.TL: Naipit ako sa likod ng guho! May kailangang mag-alis nito!

translations.EN: Can't crawl any further! Help me!
translations.TL: Hindi na ako makagapang pa! Tulungan mo ako!

translations.EN: I'm over here, behind cover! Pull me back!
translations.TL: Nandito ako sa kublihan! Hilahin mo ako pabalik!

translations.EN: Rescue me, please! They're getting closer!
translations.TL: Saklolohan mo ako, pakiusap! Papalapit na sila!

translations.EN: I need extraction! Can't walk out of here!
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng tulong makalabas! Hindi ako makakalakad!

translations.EN: Help me get out! My leg is broken!
translations.TL: Tulungan mo akong makalabas! Bali ang binti ko!

translations.EN: Haven't eaten in days... I'm starving to death.
translations.TL: Ilang araw nang hindi kumakain... namamatay na ako sa gutom.

translations.EN: Too weak from hunger to stand up. Food, please.
translations.TL: Masyadong nanghihina sa gutom para makatayo. Pagkain, pakiusap.

translations.EN: Stomach is eating itself... any crumbs left?
translations.TL: Kumakalam na ang sikmura ko... may natira pa bang mumo?

translations.EN: Starving... can't even hold my weapon.
translations.TL: Gutom na gutom... hindi ko man lang mahawakan ang sandata ko.

translations.EN: Please, just a bite of anything edible.
translations.TL: Pakiusap, kahit isang kagat lang ng anumang makakain.

translations.EN: Fainting from lack of calories. I need food.
translations.TL: Nahihiya sa kawalan ng pagkain. Kailangan ko ng makakain.

translations.EN: Hunger cramps are tearing me apart. Help me.
translations.TL: Pinupulikat ang tiyan ko sa gutom. Tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: I can't go on like this without food in my belly.
translations.TL: Hindi ko na kayang magpatuloy nang walang laman ang tiyan.

translations.EN: Empty for days... please bring me something to eat.
translations.TL: Ilang araw nang walang laman... dalhan mo ako ng makakain.

translations.EN: Starving on the floor... spare a ration, please.
translations.TL: Nagugutom sa sahig... magbahagi naman ng rasyon, pakiusap.

translations.EN: I need help with this wound.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng tulong sa sugat na 'to.

translations.EN: Hurting pretty badly here. Need aid.
translations.TL: Medyo malala ang tama ko rito. Kailangan ng gamot.

translations.EN: Got injured. Can someone look at this?
translations.TL: Nasugatan ako. May makakatingin ba nito?

translations.EN: Need medical attention before this gets worse.
translations.TL: Kailangan ng panggagamot bago lumala 'to.

translations.EN: Wound is throbbing. I need a hand.
translations.TL: Pumipintig ang sugat. Kailangan ko ng saklolo.

translations.EN: Took some damage. Could use first aid.
translations.TL: Nasaktan ako. Kailangan ko ng first aid.

translations.EN: This cut is nasty. Help me clean it.
translations.TL: Marumi ang hiwa na 'to. Tulungan mo akong linisin.

translations.EN: I'm in pain here. Need medical supplies.
translations.TL: Nasasaktan ako rito. Kailangan ko ng gamot.

translations.EN: Injured and slowing down. Need treatment.
translations.TL: Sugatan at bumabagal na. Kailangan ng lunas.

translations.EN: Got banged up pretty good. Help me patch up.
translations.TL: Nabugbog ako nang husto. Tulungan mo akong magbenda.

translations.EN: Please. I need help with this wound, don't let me die.
translations.TL: Pakiusap. Tulungan mo ako sa sugat na 'to, huwag mo akong hayaang mamatay.

translations.EN: Have mercy on me... patch me up, please.
translations.TL: Maawa ka sa akin... bendahan mo ako, pakiusap.

translations.EN: I won't survive this cut without your mercy.
translations.TL: Hindi ako mabubuhay sa hiwang 'to kung wala ang awa mo.

translations.EN: Please help... I'm begging for aid.
translations.TL: Pakiusap tulungan mo ako... nagmamakaawa ako sa lunas.

translations.EN: Don't leave me to bleed out like an animal.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong iwang maubusan ng dugo na parang hayop.

translations.EN: Show some kindness. This wound is killing me.
translations.TL: Magpakita ka ng kabutihan. Pinapatay ako ng sugat na 'to.

translations.EN: Please, just dress the wound. That's all I ask.
translations.TL: Pakiusap, gamutin lang ang sugat. 'Yon lang ang hinihiling ko.

translations.EN: I'm at your mercy. Help stop this pain.
translations.TL: Nasa awa mo ako. Tulungan mong matigil ang sakit.

translations.EN: Spare my life and treat this injury, please.
translations.TL: Iligtas mo ang buhay ko at gamutin 'tong pinsala, pakiusap.

translations.EN: I have so much to live for... please help me.
translations.TL: Marami pa akong dahilan para mabuhay... tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: I still need these wounds patched! Hurry!
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa ring mabendahan ang sugat na 'to! Bilis!

translations.EN: Where's that bandage?! Still bleeding out here!
translations.TL: Nasaan na 'yung benda?! Dumurugo pa rin ako rito!

translations.EN: Don't forget about me! I need a wrap now!
translations.TL: Huwag niyo akong kalimutan! Kailangan ko ng benda ngayon!

translations.EN: Still waiting on that bandage! It's soaking through!
translations.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ako sa benda! Bumababad na ang dugo!

translations.EN: Please, hurry with the bandages! I'm fading!
translations.TL: Pakiusap, bilisan ang benda! Nanghihina na ako!

translations.EN: I asked for a bandage! Did you find one?!
translations.TL: Humihingi ako ng benda! May nahanap ka ba?!

translations.EN: Wound is still open! Bring the dressing over!
translations.TL: Bukas pa rin ang sugat! Dalhin mo na ang pambenda!

translations.EN: Can someone please patch me up already?!
translations.TL: May magbe-benda ba sa akin ngayon din?!

translations.EN: Blood is still pooling! Get that bandage on me!
translations.TL: Nag-iipon pa rin ang dugo! Ilagay mo na ang benda sa akin!

translations.EN: Still bleeding here! Hurry with the cloth!
translations.TL: Dumurugo pa rin ako rito! Bilisan mo ang tela!

translations.EN: I am still losing blood! Please, help me!
translations.TL: Nauubusan pa rin ako ng dugo! Pakiusap, tulungan mo ako!

translations.EN: Pressure isn't working! The bleeding won't stop!
translations.TL: Hindi gumagana ang diin! Ayaw tumigil ng pagdurugo!

translations.EN: I don't have much time left... blood is gushing!
translations.TL: Wala na akong gaanong oras... bumubuhos ang dugo!

translations.EN: Hurry, damn it! I'm going to bleed to death!
translations.TL: Bilisan mo naman! Mamamatay na ako sa pagdurugo!

translations.EN: My pulse is getting weak... stop the bleed!
translations.TL: Humihina na ang pulso ko... patigilin ang pagdurugo!

translations.EN: Still bleeding out! Don't let me die on this floor!
translations.TL: Nauubusan pa rin ng dugo! Huwag mo akong hayaang mamatay sa sahig!

translations.EN: I'm freezing cold from blood loss... hurry!
translations.TL: Giniginaw na ako sa nawalang dugo... bilisan mo!

translations.EN: Blood won't clot! I need immediate help!
translations.TL: Ayaw mamuo ng dugo! Kailangan ko ng agarang tulong!

translations.EN: Everything is fading... stop the bleeding, please!
translations.TL: Naglalaho ang lahat... patigilin mo ang dugo, pakiusap!

translations.EN: Hurry up! I can't hold my own artery closed!
translations.TL: Bilisan mo! Hindi ko kayang pigilin ang ugat ko nang mag-isa!

translations.EN: I'm not up yet. Please help me.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ako nakakabangon. Pakiusap tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: Still down here! Don't leave me behind!
translations.TL: Nandito pa rin ako sa sahig! Huwag mo akong iwan!

translations.EN: I still need assistance to get on my feet.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa rin ng tulong para makatayo.

translations.EN: Can someone help me up? Still grounded.
translations.TL: May tutulong ba sa aking tumayo? Bagsak pa rin ako.

translations.EN: I'm still incapacitated! Come over here!
translations.TL: Hindi pa rin ako makakilos! Pumunta ka rito!

translations.EN: Still hurting, still stuck. Give me a hand.
translations.TL: Masakit pa rin, naipit pa rin. Tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: Haven't moved an inch. Need someone to help.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ako nakakagalaw kahit kaunti. Kailangan ng tulong.

translations.EN: Please, I'm still on the ground waiting.
translations.TL: Pakiusap, nasa lupa pa rin ako at naghihintay.

translations.EN: Still can't stand. Don't forget I'm down.
translations.TL: Hindi pa rin makatayo. Huwag mong kalimutang bagsak ako.

translations.EN: I'm still here! Help me up already!
translations.TL: Nandito pa rin ako! Tulungan mo na akong tumayo!

translations.EN: I still need water to recover. My throat is on fire.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa rin ng tubig para makabawi. Parang may apoy sa lalamunan ko.

translations.EN: Still dying of thirst... did you find any bottle?
translations.TL: Mamamatay pa rin sa uhaw... may nahanap ka bang bote?

translations.EN: Water, please! I can't take this parched feeling.
translations.TL: Tubig, pakiusap! Hindi ko na makayanan ang matinding uhaw.

translations.EN: I asked for water... please tell me you have some.
translations.TL: Humihingi ako ng tubig... sabihin mong may dala ka.

translations.EN: Tongue feels like sandpaper. Bring water quickly.
translations.TL: Parang liha ang dila ko. Magdala ka ng tubig agad.

translations.EN: Still completely dehydrated. I can't stand up like this.
translations.TL: Dehydrated pa rin ako. Hindi ako makakatayo nang ganito.

translations.EN: Water... I'm begging you, just one cup.
translations.TL: Tubig... nagmamakaawa ako, kahit isang baso lang.

translations.EN: Still dry as bone. Please bring hydration.
translations.TL: Tuyot pa rin ako. Pakiusap dalhan mo ako ng tubig.

translations.EN: I can't recover without liquids. Help me.
translations.TL: Hindi ako makakabawi nang walang inumin. Tulong.

translations.EN: Still waiting for a drink... head is pounding.
translations.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng maiinom... sumasakit ang ulo ko.

translations.EN: I still need a little more time to recover.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa ng kaunting oras para makabawi.

translations.EN: Can't rush this. My muscles are completely dead.
translations.TL: Hindi pwedeng madaliin. Patay na ang lakas ng kalamnan ko.

translations.EN: Still catching my breath. Give me another minute.
translations.TL: Hinihingal pa rin ako. Bigyan mo pa ako ng isang minuto.

translations.EN: Body won't budge yet. Just a bit more rest.
translations.TL: Ayaw pang gumalaw ng katawan ko. Kaunting pahinga pa.

translations.EN: Still wiped out. Don't force me to stand yet.
translations.TL: Ubos pa rin ako. Huwag mo muna akong piliting tumayo.

translations.EN: Heart is still racing. Need more time sitting down.
translations.TL: Mabilis pa rin ang kabog ng dibdib ko. Kailangan pang umupo.

translations.EN: Not ready to move yet. Fatigue is overwhelming.
translations.TL: Hindi pa handang kumilos. Masyadong mabigat ang pagod.

translations.EN: Give me another thirty seconds... almost there.
translations.TL: Bigyan mo pa ako ng tatlumpung segundo... malapit na.

translations.EN: Still completely spent. Let my legs rest.
translations.TL: Sagad pa rin ang pagod. Pahingahin mo muna ang mga binti ko.

translations.EN: Can't run yet. Need a little more recovery.
translations.TL: Hindi pa makakatakbo. Kailangan pa ng kaunting lakas.

translations.EN: I am still asking you to spare me. Please.
translations.TL: Hinihiling ko pa rin na buhayin mo ako. Pakiusap.

translations.EN: Please don't change your mind... let me live.
translations.TL: Pakiusap huwag magbago ang isip mo... hayaan mo akong mabuhay.

translations.EN: I'm still begging for mercy. Don't shoot.
translations.TL: Nagmamakaawa pa rin ako sa awa. Huwag kang bumaril.

translations.EN: Show mercy once more. I mean you no harm.
translations.TL: Maawa ka pa ulit. Wala akong masamang balak sa'yo.

translations.EN: I am defenseless. Please keep your weapon down.
translations.TL: Wala akong laban. Pakiusap ibaba mo ang sandata mo.

translations.EN: Don't finish me off. I surrender completely.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong tapusin. Sumusuko ako nang buo.

translations.EN: Still pleading for my life. Have pity on me.
translations.TL: Nagmamakaawa pa rin para sa buhay ko. Kaawaan mo ako.

translations.EN: Please... I just want to survive.
translations.TL: Pakiusap... gusto ko lang mabuhay.

translations.EN: I'm at your feet. Spare me, I beg you.
translations.TL: Nasa paanan mo na ako. Huwag mo akong patayin, nagmamakaawa ako.

translations.EN: Don't execute me. Let me crawl away.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong patayin. Hayaan mo akong gumapang palayo.

translations.EN: I am still down here! Do not leave me!
translations.TL: Nandito pa rin ako sa sahig! Huwag niyo akong iwan!

translations.EN: Don't abandon me! Come back and pull me out!
translations.TL: Huwag niyo akong iwanan! Bumalik kayo at hilahin ako palabas!

translations.EN: Still trapped in this spot! Need someone here!
translations.TL: Naipit pa rin sa pwestong 'to! Kailangan ko ng tao rito!

translations.EN: Where are you going?! I can't walk!
translations.TL: Saan ka pupunta?! Hindi ako makalakad!

translations.EN: Please come back! I'm completely stranded!
translations.TL: Pakiusap bumalik ka! Nastranded ako nang buo!

translations.EN: Don't walk away from my cries! Help me!
translations.TL: Huwag mong talikuran ang tawag ko! Tulungan mo ako!

translations.EN: Still stuck under this weight! Lift it off!
translations.TL: Naipit pa rin sa bigat na 'to! Buhatin mo 'to!

translations.EN: I'm still here! Get me out before they find me!
translations.TL: Nandito pa rin ako! Ilabas mo ako bago nila ako makita!

translations.EN: Rescue me, damn it! I can't drag myself!
translations.TL: Saklolohan mo ako! Hindi ko kayang kaladkarin ang sarili ko!

translations.EN: Don't leave me behind to rot! Come back!
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong iwang mabulok dito! Bumalik ka!

translations.EN: I still need something to eat. I'm fading fast.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa rin ng makakain. Mabilis akong nanghihina.

translations.EN: Still starving... any canned food, anything?
translations.TL: Gutom na gutom pa rin... kahit anong de-lata, kahit ano?

translations.EN: Can't recover without calories. Bring food, please.
translations.TL: Hindi makakabawi nang walang laman ang tiyan. Magdala ka ng pagkain.

translations.EN: Stomach pains won't stop. I need nourishment.
translations.TL: Ayaw tumigil ng sakit ng tiyan ko. Kailangan ko ng pagkain.

translations.EN: Still starving to the bone. Did you find a ration?
translations.TL: Gutom na gutom pa rin hanggang buto. May nahanap ka bang rasyon?

translations.EN: Please hurry with some food. I'm too dizzy to stand.
translations.TL: Pakiusap bilisan ang pagkain. Nahihilo na ako para makatayo.

translations.EN: Hunger is unbearable now. Help me.
translations.TL: Hindi na makayanan ang gutom. Tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: Still haven't eaten. Don't let me starve on this floor.
translations.TL: Wala pa ring kinakain. Huwag mo akong hayaang magutom sa sahig.

translations.EN: Need a meal to get back on my feet.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng makakain para makatayo ulit.

translations.EN: Still empty... please, just a cracker or some beans.
translations.TL: Walang laman pa rin... kahit biskwit o kaunting beans lang.

translations.EN: They are hurt! Stay with them while I cover you.
translations.TL: Nasaktan sila! Samahan mo sila habang binabantayan ko kayo.

translations.EN: Our companion is down! Tend to them, I've got guard.
translations.TL: Bagsak ang kasama natin! Gamutin mo, babantayan ko kayo.

translations.EN: They're injured! Get them patched up while I watch.
translations.TL: Sugatan sila! Bendahan mo habang nagmamasid ako.

translations.EN: Check on them right now! I'll hold off the threats.
translations.TL: Tignan mo sila ngayon din! Haharangin ko ang mga kalaban.

translations.EN: They took a hit! See to their wounds, I'm watching.
translations.TL: Tinamaan sila! Tingnan mo ang sugat nila, nakabantay ako.

translations.EN: Partner is wounded! Apply first aid, I've got your back.
translations.TL: Sugatan ang kasama! Maglapat ng first aid, hawak ko likod niyo.

translations.EN: They're bleeding! Patch them while I keep perimeter.
translations.TL: Dumurugo sila! Gamutin mo habang binabantayan ko ang paligid.

translations.EN: Help them up! I'll keep the lane clear.
translations.TL: Tulungan mo silang tumayo! Lilinisin ko ang daanan.

translations.EN: They need attention! Administer aid, I'll protect you both.
translations.TL: Kailangan nila ng lunas! Gamutin mo, poprotektahan ko kayong dalawa.

translations.EN: Our friend is hurt! Help them, I'm standing sentry.
translations.TL: Nasaktan ang kaibigan natin! Tulungan mo sila, nakabantay ako.

translations.EN: I found a bandage for them. Hold still while I patch them up.
translations.TL: Nakahanap ako ng benda para sa kanila. Huwag kang gagalaw habang ginagamot ko sila.

translations.EN: Got a dressing right here. Wrapping the wound now.
translations.TL: May pambenda ako rito. Binabalot ko na ang sugat ngayon.

translations.EN: Found medical supplies! Hold on, I'm dressing the injury.
translations.TL: Nakahanap ako ng gamot! Kapit lang, ginagamot ko na ang pinsala.

translations.EN: I've got clean cloth. Hold steady while I bind it.
translations.TL: May malinis akong tela. Manatiling nakapirmi habang itinatali ko.

translations.EN: Located a bandage. Applying pressure to their cut now.
translations.TL: May nahanap na benda. Dinidiinan ko na ang hiwa nila.

translations.EN: I've got medical wrap. Don't squirm, I'm securing it.
translations.TL: May medical wrap ako. Huwag kang pumalag, inaayos ko na.

translations.EN: Found supplies for them. Wrapping it up tightly now.
translations.TL: May nahanap na gamit para sa kanila. Binabalot ko na nang mahigpit.

translations.EN: Got the bandage ready. Applying it to the laceration.
translations.TL: Handa na ang benda. Nilalapat ko na sa sugat.

translations.EN: I have aid gear. Hold still, you'll be stable in a minute.
translations.TL: May gamit ako rito. Huwag gagalaw, magiging maayos ka rin agad.

translations.EN: Bandage in hand! Dressing their wounds right now.
translations.TL: Hawak ko na ang benda! Ginagamot ko na ang mga sugat nila.

translations.EN: I am out of bandages! Can someone spare one for them?
translations.TL: Naubusan ako ng benda! May makakapagbahagi ba ng isa para sa kanila?

translations.EN: No more medical cloth! Does anyone have a bandage?!
translations.TL: Wala nang telang panggamot! May benda ba ang kahit sino sa inyo?!

translations.EN: My pack is empty of dressings! Help them, quick!
translations.TL: Walang laman ang bag ko para sa benda! Tulungan niyo sila, bilis!

translations.EN: I can't treat this wound without supplies! Check your packs!
translations.TL: Hindi ko magagamot ang sugat na 'to nang walang gamit! Tignan ang mga bag niyo!

translations.EN: We're out of first aid! Who has a clean rag?!
translations.TL: Wala na tayong first aid! Sino may malinis na basahan?!

translations.EN: I don't have what I need to stop their bleeding! Find supplies!
translations.TL: Wala sa akin ang kailangan para mapatigil ang dugo nila! Maghanap ng gamit!

translations.EN: Zero bandages left! Someone hand me medical gear!
translations.TL: Ubos na ang benda! May mag-abot sa akin ng panggamot!

translations.EN: I'm empty-handed! We need bandages for our friend now!
translations.TL: Wala akong hawak! Kailangan natin ng benda para sa kaibigan natin ngayon din!

translations.EN: No antiseptic, no bandages. Search the drawers, fast!
translations.TL: Walang antiseptic, walang benda. Maghalughog sa mga drawer, bilis!

translations.EN: I can't patch them up alone! Who has medical tools?!
translations.TL: Hindi ko sila kayang gamutin mag-isa! Sino may kagamitang medikal?!

translations.EN: The wound is treated. I can move when you are ready.
translations.TL: Nagamot na ang sugat. Makakakilos na ako kapag handa ka na.

translations.EN: Bandaged up tight. Good to go when you are.
translations.TL: Nabendahan nang mahigpit. Handa nang umalis kapag handa ka na.

translations.EN: Bleeding has stopped. Ready to step out.
translations.TL: Tumigil na ang dugo. Handa nang lumabas.

translations.EN: Dressings are secure. I can walk now.
translations.TL: Ligtas na ang benda. Makakalakad na ako ngayon.

translations.EN: That did the trick. I'm back on my feet.
translations.TL: Bumisa 'yon. Nakatayo na ulit ako.

translations.EN: Wrapped up properly. Lead on.
translations.TL: Nabalot na nang maayos. Manguna ka na.

translations.EN: Wound is stabilized. Ready for your call.
translations.TL: Maayos na ang sugat. Handa sa utos mo.

translations.EN: Bandage is holding. Let's get moving.
translations.TL: Kumakapit ang benda. Kilos na tayo.

translations.EN: Cleanly wrapped. I'm ready to follow.
translations.TL: Malinis na nabalutan. Handa na akong sumunod.

translations.EN: All patched up. Let's hit the road.
translations.TL: Maayos na ang lahat. Tara na sa daan.

translations.EN: Thank you. That treatment helped.
translations.TL: Salamat. Malaking tulong ang panggagamot na 'yon.

translations.EN: Feeling much better. I appreciate the aid.
translations.TL: Medyo maayos na pakiramdam ko. Salamat sa tulong.

translations.EN: Much better now. Thank you for patching me up.
translations.TL: Mas maayos na ngayon. Salamat sa paggamot sa akin.

translations.EN: Pain is subsiding. Thanks for taking care of it.
translations.TL: Humuhupa na ang sakit. Salamat sa pag-asikaso no'n.

translations.EN: Good work on that treatment. I'm indebted to you.
translations.TL: Magaling ang panggagamot mo. May utang na loob ako sa'yo.

translations.EN: That took the edge off. Thank you.
translations.TL: Nabawasan ang kirot. Salamat sa'yo.

translations.EN: I can function again. Thanks for the quick aid.
translations.TL: Makakagalaw na ulit ako. Salamat sa mabilis na lunas.

translations.EN: Appreciate the medical help. I owe you one.
translations.TL: Salamat sa tulong medikal. May utang ako sa'yo.

translations.EN: Thanks, that helped a lot. Ready to move.
translations.TL: Salamat, malaking tulong 'yon. Handa nang kumilos.

translations.EN: You saved my skin with that aid. Thank you.
translations.TL: Iniligtas mo ang buhay ko sa lunas na 'yon. Maraming salamat.

translations.EN: I am still down and waiting for a patch.
translations.TL: Nasa sahig pa rin ako at naghihintay ng benda.

translations.EN: Still on the floor. Where is that bandage?
translations.TL: Nasa sahig pa rin. Nasaan na 'yung benda?

translations.EN: Wound is still unbandaged. Need it wrapped soon.
translations.TL: Wala pa ring benda ang sugat. Kailangang balutin na agad.

translations.EN: Still waiting for someone to bind this cut.
translations.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng magtatali sa hiwang 'to.

translations.EN: Blood is still seeping through. Need that wrap.
translations.TL: Tumutulo pa rin ang dugo. Kailangan ko ng pambalot.

translations.EN: Still grounded until these wounds get dressed.
translations.TL: Bagsak pa rin hangga't hindi nagagamot ang mga sugat na 'to.

translations.EN: Waiting on clean cloth. Can't stand like this.
translations.TL: Naghihintay ng malinis na tela. Hindi makatayo nang ganito.

translations.EN: Still down here waiting for first aid.
translations.TL: Nandito pa rin sa sahig at naghihintay ng first aid.

translations.EN: Unpatched and bleeding. Please hurry.
translations.TL: Walang benda at dumurugo. Pakiusap bilisan mo.

translations.EN: Still need that dressing applied. Don't delay.
translations.TL: Kailangan pa ring ilapat ang pambenda. Huwag patagalin.

translations.EN: The bleeding has not stopped. I still need a bandage.
translations.TL: Hindi pa tumitigil ang dugo. Kailangan ko pa rin ng benda.

translations.EN: Still hemorrhaging. I need pressure and a wrap immediately.
translations.TL: Patuloy pa ring umaagos ang dugo. Kailangan ng diin at benda agad.

translations.EN: Bleeding is continuing. I'm getting lightheaded.
translations.TL: Dumurugo pa rin. Nahihilo na ako.

translations.EN: Blood is still flowing. Please get that bandage on me.
translations.TL: Umaagos pa rin ang dugo. Pakiusap lagyan mo na ako ng benda.

translations.EN: Hasn't stopped bleeding yet. Running out of time.
translations.TL: Hindi pa rin humihinto ang pagdurugo. Nauubusan na ako ng oras.

translations.EN: Still losing red. My clothes are soaked.
translations.TL: Nauubusan pa rin ng dugo. Babad na ang damit ko.

translations.EN: The wound won't seal itself. Need a dressing now.
translations.TL: Hindi kusang magsasara ang sugat. Kailangan ng benda ngayon din.

translations.EN: Still bleeding steadily. Hurry up with the aid.
translations.TL: Tuloy-tuloy pa rin ang pagdurugo. Bilisan mo ang tulong.

translations.EN: Losing blood by the second. Please hurry.
translations.TL: Bawat segundo nauubusan ako ng dugo. Pakiusap magmadali ka.

translations.EN: The cut won't stop bleeding. Wrap it, please.
translations.TL: Ayaw tumigil ng pagdurugo ng hiwa. Balutin mo na, pakiusap.

translations.EN: I am still down. I still need help.
translations.TL: Bagsak pa rin ako. Kailangan ko pa rin ng tulong.

translations.EN: Still incapacitated on the ground. Please assist.
translations.TL: Hindi pa rin makakilos sa lupa. Pakiusap tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: Haven't recovered yet. Still need a hand.
translations.TL: Hindi pa nakakabawi. Kailangan pa rin ng saklolo.

translations.EN: Still down here. Don't leave me alone.
translations.TL: Nandito pa rin sa sahig. Huwag mo akong iwang mag-isa.

translations.EN: Status unchanged: still injured and waiting.
translations.TL: Walang pagbabago: sugatan pa rin at naghihintay.

translations.EN: Still grounded. I need someone to help me up.
translations.TL: Bagsak pa rin. Kailangan ko ng tutulong sa akin makatayo.

translations.EN: Can't move on my own yet. Still need aid.
translations.TL: Hindi pa makagalaw mag-isa. Kailangan pa rin ng lunas.

translations.EN: Still unable to stand. Waiting for help.
translations.TL: Hindi pa rin makatayo. Naghihintay ng tulong.

translations.EN: I'm still down in the dirt. Please assist me.
translations.TL: Nasa lupa pa rin ako. Pakiusap saklolohan mo ako.

translations.EN: Still waiting for support. Don't forget me.
translations.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng suporta. Huwag mo akong kalimutan.

translations.EN: I still need water before I can move.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa rin ng tubig bago makakilos.

translations.EN: Thirst is still crippling me. Bring hydration.
translations.TL: Pinapahirapan pa rin ako ng uhaw. Magdala ka ng tubig.

translations.EN: Can't stand until I drink something clean.
translations.TL: Hindi makakatayo hangga't hindi umiinom ng malinis.

translations.EN: Still parched and dizzy. Where is the water?
translations.TL: Tuyot at nahihilo pa rin. Nasaan na ang tubig?

translations.EN: Dehydration hasn't improved. I need fluids now.
translations.TL: Hindi pa gumagaling ang dehydration. Kailangan ko ng inumin ngayon.

translations.EN: Still desperately thirsty. Bring a bottle over.
translations.TL: Uhaw na uhaw pa rin ako. Dalhin mo ang bote rito.

translations.EN: Throat is still locked up dry. Need water.
translations.TL: Nakatuyot pa rin ang lalamunan ko. Kailangan ng tubig.

translations.EN: Can't make progress without hydration. Help me.
translations.TL: Hindi makakausad nang walang tubig. Tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: Still waiting on that drink. Feeling very weak.
translations.TL: Naghihintay pa rin sa inumin. Sobrang nanghihina na.

translations.EN: Need fluids before my legs will work again.
translations.TL: Kailangan ng inumin bago gumana ulit ang mga binti ko.

translations.EN: I still need time to recover my strength.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa ng oras para manumbalik ang lakas ko.

translations.EN: Stamina is still drained. Catching my breath.
translations.TL: Ubos pa rin ang stamina. Humihinga pa rin.

translations.EN: Still exhausted. Give me a little more time.
translations.TL: Pagod na pagod pa rin. Bigyan mo pa ako ng kaunting oras.

translations.EN: Muscles are still aching. Recovering slowly.
translations.TL: Kumikirot pa rin ang kalamnan. Dahan-dahang nagpapagaling.

translations.EN: Lungs still burning from running. Give me a moment.
translations.TL: Nasusunog pa rin ang baga sa pagtakbo. Bigyan mo ako ng saglit.

translations.EN: Fatigue hasn't cleared yet. Still resting here.
translations.TL: Hindi pa humuhupa ang pagod. Nagpapahinga pa rin dito.

translations.EN: Energy is very low. Still need a few breaths.
translations.TL: Napakababa pa ng lakas. Kailangan pa ng ilang malalalim na hininga.

translations.EN: Legs are still shaking from exhaustion. Give me time.
translations.TL: Nanginginig pa rin ang mga binti sa pagod. Bigyan mo ako ng oras.

translations.EN: Still spent. Don't rush me to run again.
translations.TL: Ubos pa rin. Huwag mo akong apurahin tumakbo ulit.

translations.EN: Recharging my stamina. Just a little longer.
translations.TL: Nagpapalakas ulit. Kaunti na lang.

translations.EN: I am still down. Please do not finish me.
translations.TL: Bagsak pa rin ako. Pakiusap huwag mo akong tapusin.

translations.EN: Still helpless here. Spare my life, please.
translations.TL: Walang laban pa rin dito. Buhayin mo ako, pakiusap.

translations.EN: I'm still no threat to you. Please have mercy.
translations.TL: Wala pa rin akong banta sa'yo. Pakiusap maawa ka.

translations.EN: Still begging for survival. Don't hurt me.
translations.TL: Nagmamakaawa pa rin para mabuhay. Huwag mo akong saktan.

translations.EN: Plea remains: spare me and let me crawl away.
translations.TL: Hiling ko pa rin: buhayin mo ako at hayaang gumapang palayo.

translations.EN: I surrender completely. Please do not execute me.
translations.TL: Sumusuko ako nang buo. Pakiusap huwag mo akong patayin.

translations.EN: Still at your mercy. Please keep that weapon away.
translations.TL: Nasa awa mo pa rin ako. Pakiusap ilayo mo ang sandata na 'yan.

translations.EN: I have surrendered. Don't strike a downed person.
translations.TL: Sumuko na ako. Huwag kang manakit ng taong nakahandusay.

translations.EN: Please honor your mercy. Don't kill me.
translations.TL: Pakiusap tuparin mo ang awa mo. Huwag mo akong patayin.

translations.EN: Still alive, still pleading. Let me survive this.
translations.TL: Buhay pa, nagmamakaawa pa rin. Hayaan mo akong makaraos dito.

translations.EN: I am still here. Please come back for me.
translations.TL: Nandito pa rin ako. Pakiusap balikan mo ako.

translations.EN: Still trapped in place. Waiting for your rescue.
translations.TL: Naipit pa rin sa pwesto. Naghihintay sa saklolo mo.

translations.EN: Don't leave me stranded! I'm still where you left me.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong iwang nastranded! Nandito pa rin ako sa iniwanan mo.

translations.EN: Still cannot walk out alone. Come help me.
translations.TL: Hindi pa rin makalabas nang mag-isa. Halika tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: Waiting on rescue here. Hurry before dead arrive.
translations.TL: Naghihintay ng saklolo rito. Bilisan mo bago dumating ang mga patay.

translations.EN: Still pinned down. Please extract me.
translations.TL: Naiipit pa rin. Pakiusap hilahin mo ako palabas.

translations.EN: Don't forget me here! Still need someone to pull me out.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong kalimutan dito! Kailangan pa rin ng maghihila sa akin.

translations.EN: Status unchanged: trapped and waiting for assistance.
translations.TL: Walang pagbabago: naipit at naghihintay ng saklolo.

translations.EN: Still waiting for someone to drag me to safety.
translations.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng hihila sa akin sa ligtas na lugar.

translations.EN: I'm still right here. Please don't leave me behind.
translations.TL: Nandito lang ako. Pakiusap huwag mo akong iwan.

translations.EN: I still need food before I can get up.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko pa rin ng pagkain bago makatayo.

translations.EN: Starvation is worsening. Did you find anything edible?
translations.TL: Lumalala ang gutom ko. May nahanap ka bang makakain?

translations.EN: Still too weak from hunger to stand.
translations.TL: Nanghihina pa rin sa gutom para makatayo.

translations.EN: Can't move on an empty stomach. Bring food.
translations.TL: Hindi makakilos nang walang laman ang tiyan. Dalhan mo ako ng pagkain.

translations.EN: Still starving on the floor. Please bring a ration.
translations.TL: Nagugutom pa rin sa sahig. Pakiusap dalhan mo ako ng rasyon.

translations.EN: Body needs calories right now. I'm fading.
translations.TL: Kailangan ng katawan ng pagkain ngayon din. Nanghihina na ako.

translations.EN: Still waiting for a meal. Stomach cramps are brutal.
translations.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng pagkain. Matindi ang pulikat ng tiyan ko.

translations.EN: Can't regain strength without food. Help me.
translations.TL: Hindi maibabalik ang lakas nang walang pagkain. Tulungan mo ako.

translations.EN: Still starving here. Any can of beans or soup?
translations.TL: Gutom pa rin ako rito. May de-latang beans ba o sabaw?

translations.EN: Need nourishment before I can take a step.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng makakain bago ako makahakbang.

translations.EN: I am hurt! I need help now!
translations.TL: Sugatan ako! Kailangan ko ng tulong ngayon na!

translations.EN: Emergency! I need immediate medical attention!
translations.TL: Kagipitan! Kailangan ko ng agarang gamot ngayon din!

translations.EN: Hit bad! Come over here right now!
translations.TL: Grabe ang tama ko! Halika rito ngayon din!

translations.EN: Urgent! I'm bleeding and falling down!
translations.TL: Apurahan! Dumurugo ako at bumabagsak!

translations.EN: I need aid this second! Hurry!
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng gamot sa segundong ito! Bilis!

translations.EN: Severe injury! Drop what you're doing and help me!
translations.TL: Malubhang pinsala! Bitawan ang ginagawa mo at tulungan mo ako!

translations.EN: I won't last long without treatment! Now!
translations.TL: Hindi ako magtatagal nang walang gamot! Ngayon na!

translations.EN: Critical wound! Bandage me now!
translations.TL: Kritikal na sugat! Bendahan mo ako ngayon din!

translations.EN: I'm going down hard! Medic, help me!
translations.TL: Bumabagsak na ako! Saklolo, tulungan mo ako!

translations.EN: Urgent distress! Someone patch me up right now!
translations.TL: Apurahang saklolo! May magbenda sa akin ngayon din!
